mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO show_subscribe (user_id, show_id, notify_before_minutes, notified_pre, notified_open, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{showId}, #{notifyBeforeMinutes}, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM show_subscribe WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND show_id = #{showId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM show_subscribe WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND show_id = #{showId}

SELECT ss.id, ss.user_id, ss.show_id, ss.notify_before_minutes, ss.notified_pre, ss.notified_open, ss.create_time, ss.update_time, s.id AS s_id, s.name AS s_name, s.poster_url AS s_poster_url, s.venue AS s_venue, s.open_sale_time AS s_open_sale_time FROM show_subscribe ss JOIN `show` s ON s.id = ss.show_id WHERE ss.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ss.create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM show_subscribe WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ss.id, ss.user_id, ss.show_id, ss.notify_before_minutes, ss.notified_pre, ss.notified_open, ss.create_time, ss.update_time, s.id AS s_id, s.name AS s_name, s.poster_url AS s_poster_url, s.venue AS s_venue, s.open_sale_time AS s_open_sale_time FROM show_subscribe ss JOIN `show` s ON s.id = ss.show_id WHERE ss.notified_pre = 0 AND s.open_sale_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE_SUB(s.open_sale_time, INTERVAL ss.notify_before_minutes MINUTE) <= #{now} AND s.open_sale_time > #{now} LIMIT 200

SELECT ss.id, ss.user_id, ss.show_id, ss.notify_before_minutes, ss.notified_pre, ss.notified_open, ss.create_time, ss.update_time, s.id AS s_id, s.name AS s_name, s.poster_url AS s_poster_url, s.venue AS s_venue, s.open_sale_time AS s_open_sale_time FROM show_subscribe ss JOIN `show` s ON s.id = ss.show_id WHERE ss.notified_open = 0 AND s.open_sale_time IS NOT NULL AND s.open_sale_time <= #{now} LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE show_subscribe SET notified_pre = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE show_subscribe SET notified_open = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
